scene.luxury_salon_room.description: Institutional laboratory facility - open space, not enclosed by walls
scene.luxury_salon_room.contents: Cold sterile facility with open grey space. Grey laboratory walls at depth with normal ambient lighting. Subject spotlit brighter than background.

scene.floor_emphasis.description: Open institutional space with visible flooring
scene.floor_emphasis.contents: Laboratory flooring visible with perspective. Polished high-end laboratory tile - expensive, pristine, state-of-the-art facility. Space extends beyond immediate surroundings.

scene.salon_details.description: Laboratory facility equipment - visible at mid-height/wall level
scene.salon_details.contents: Room details showing laboratory facility. Equipment behind subject at table height and wall-mounted - panels, carts, dispensers visible at mid-level.

scene.environment_rendering.description: Environment rendered with depth - institutional context

scene.clinic_background_blur.description: Blurry clinic background for close-up shots
scene.clinic_background_blur.contents: Background OUT OF FOCUS - soft blur. Grey clinical walls. Metal cabinet edges. Stainless surfaces catching light. Laboratory equipment suggestions. All details blurred and indistinct. Clinical facility atmosphere without sharp detail.

lighting.harsh_overhead_led.description: Cold white-blue spotlight on subject with bright speculars
lighting.harsh_overhead_led.contents: Cold white-blue LED spotlight (6500-7000K) on subject - NO yellow, NO warm tones. Subject brightly lit, background normally lit. All sparkles, sequins, rhinestones render pure white speculars. Sharp clinical brightness reveals surface detail. Dimensional form through defined contrasts. Strong directional shadows under features. UNFLATTERING overhead angle - NOT portrait lighting, NOT beauty lighting. Harsh direct light that reveals rather than conceals. Documentary capture under institutional fluorescents.

lighting.harsh_shadow_modeling.description: Defined shadow modeling - bright overhead light contrast
lighting.harsh_shadow_modeling.contents: CRUEL OVERHEAD LIGHT casting deep shadows under eyes, nose, chin. Unflattering angle emphasizes fatigue. NOT soft, NOT diffused, NOT flattering. Direct harsh institutional light. Shadows sharply defined with hard edges.

dissonance.dress_vs_environment.description: Dress shines jarringly in harsh laboratory space
dissonance.dress_vs_environment.contents: Shiny dress stands out against cold grey laboratory space. Clashes with bright overhead LED lighting.
